name: Fantasy RPG
tagline: Intersection of medieval manuscript and game menu: gold highlight, inscription title and inventory grid.
best: RPG menus, character sheet, inventory and quest log
avoid: fast operation panels, dense table displays
signature: **Inscription title:** Cinzel, broad tracking, uppercase; The title stands like a sign.
**Gold single accent:** Gold solo valuable action and rarity tag; There is no second warm color.
**Inventory grid:** 4 columns, equal box ratio, rarity tag mono.
**Thin double line:** section separator 1px + 40% opacity second line.
must: Headers are in the uppercase and display family; body serif and sentence layout.
Accent solo rarity and primary action.
Corner ≤ 6px on cards; The ornamental frame line is single.
essence: Fantasy RPG reduces the ornament to a single line to keep an inventory and quest log readable; The weight comes from the typography.
brief: Design fantasy RPG character sheet: gold highlight solo rarity and main action; Inscription title, serif body, 4 column inventory.

name: Sci-Fi Cockpit
tagline: Cockpit panel language: wide-letter technical title, blue signal accent and gauge strips.
best: space/vehicle game HUD, system monitoring, telemetry
signature: **Extensive tracking:** 0.1em on Michroma head; tech label feeling.
**Blue signal:** accent active system and measurement only; line instead of fill.
**Measuring tape:** 4px high indicators, mono label on the right.
**Sharp panel:** 2px corner, 1px border, no shadows.
must: Accent is used as a line/label, not as a broad background.
All measurements are written in units and time intervals.
Panel corner ≤ 4px; edge instead of shadow.
essence: The Sci-Fi Cockpit maintains the measurement discipline of a cockpit: each display is tied to a threshold and changes color only in danger.
brief: Design spacecraft cockpit panel: wide tracking technical hood, blue signal accent only on measurement and active system, sharp panel.

name: Retro Console
tagline: Cartridge era console: pixel header, amber accent, 0 corners and narrow screen rhythm.
best: retro game menus, archive/showcase, event page
signature: **Pixel display:** Press Start 2P title and button only; It is not used for more than 3 lines.
**Amber accent:** single warm color; blue is not added as a second color.
**Zero corner:** all boxes 0–2px; there is no shadow.
**Narrow line:** body 14–15px, line spacing 1.7 — the readability gap of the pixel font is closed.
must: Pixel font only title/label; The body is a legible sans-serif.
Title no more than 3 lines, uppercase.
Corner 0–2px; shadow is not used.
mustNot: Putting pixel font in body text.
essence: Retro Console keeps pixel aesthetics at the limit of readability: title pixel, body calm; Nostalgia is not ornament but rhythm.
brief: Design 16-bit console menu: pixel title three lines only, amber accent single, sharp corner, body readable sans.

name: Esports League
tagline: Broadcast graphic language: giant banner, purple accent, match card and right-aligned scoreboards.
best: esports league, tournament page, live score panel
avoid: calm corporate product pages, long articles
signature: **Giant display:** Anton 56px, tight line spacing, uppercase — poster effect.
**Purple accent:** single energy color; Orange is not used as a rival color.
**Match card:** two team blocks, VS in the middle, mono score at the bottom.
**Scoreboard:** numbers aligned to the right, hairline instead of zebra.
must: Score and ranking numbers are tabular and right aligned.
Accent solo winner/live status and CTA.
Title in uppercase, body in sentence order.
essence: Esports League uses the hierarchy of a broadcast chart: the viewer must see who is ahead in two seconds.
brief: Design esports tournament page: giant uppercase header, purple accent lone winner and CTA, match card + right-aligned scoreboard.

name: Indie Pixel
tagline: Indie gaming showcase: pixel sticker, green accent, low-contrast panel and handmade irregularity.
best: indie game trailer, developer diary, jam page
avoid: corporate product pages high density table
signature: **Pixel label:** Silkscreen only nav, label and button; body Space Grotesque.
**Green accent:** color of vitality; The only contrast is the purple background.
**Sharp box:** 0–2px corner, 1px border.
**Hand-laid irregularity:** card spacing is uneven (14/18px), grid is deliberately broken.
must: Pixel font only label/button; The body is read in the family.
Accent single; Status information is also given via text.
Corner 0–2px.
mustNot: Using a pixel font in a paragraph.
essence: Indie Pixel retains handcrafted mess rather than big studio polish; but readability and hierarchy are non-negotiable.
brief: Design an indie game demo page: pixel labels, green accent, sharp box, deliberately irregular card spacing.

name: Card TCG
tagline: Trading card language: rarity frame, red seal, narrow column and mono imprint.
best: card game, collectible gallery, limited edition showcase
signature: **Rarity border:** card edge 1px accent 34%; As rarity increases, only edge opacity increases.
**Red seal:** accent solo rarity and main action; There is no wide ground.
**Narrow column:** card text 32ch, imprint mono 10.5px.
**Paper texture:** 3% grain, on large surface only.
must: Card text does not exceed 34ch; imprint mono and taboos.
Rarity is written not only by edge opacity but also by the label.
Accent is not used as a wide ground.
mustNot: More than 3 points on the card.
essence: Card TCG allows a card to be read in two seconds: name, rarity, number and rule follow the same column rhythm.
brief: Design trading card gallery: rarity frame, red seal accent, 32ch card text, mono imprint.

name: Survival Craft
tagline: Survival interface: dirty green accent, thick mono label, durability bars and rough cut.
feeling: raw, functional, "number of ingredients is certain"
signature: **Thick body:** Nunito 16px/1.7 — won't get tired with long inventory lists.
**Dirty green accent:** nature reference; not bright neon.
**Durability bars:** 6px, accent padding, mono percent tag.
**Rough cut:** 2/6px corner, 1px border, no shadows.
must: Source numbers mono and tabular; The unit is always written.
Accent solo status and fill bar.
Corner ≤ 6px.
essence: Survival Craft makes the inventory read like a story: what's in each line, how many are there, and what they're for.
brief: Design survival game inventory: dirty green accent, thick body, stamina bars and mono resource numbers.

name: Mobile Casual
tagline: Clear theme in mobile gaming language: coral accent, soft round card and one-touch hierarchy.
best: mobile game menu, daily quest, reward screen
signature: **Soft card:** 14/20px corner, single level shadow; mobile touch target 48px.
**Coral accent:** brown-red tone; No pink-purple children's palette.
**Single touch:** single primary action per screen.
**Round icon:** 24px box, 2px line.
must: Touch target ≥ 48px; Buttons are full width.
Single primary action per screen.
Contrast body ≥ 4.5:1 (in a light theme, the accent is darkened).
essence: Mobile Casual reduces the hierarchy to a single column on a thumb screen; Color carries joy, not confusion.
brief: Design mobile game daily quest screen: light backdrop, coral accent single, 48px touch target, round card.

name: Horror Occult
tagline: Horror interface: blood red seal, thin serif header, wide black space and mono alert lines.
best: horror game menu, story archive, thematic event
signature: **Thin serif:** Cormorant 48px/400; The title whispers, not shouts.
**Blood red:** accent only warning and main action; No decorative use.
**Wide black space:** section spacing 88px; Emptiness creates a feeling of threat.
**Mono alert:** 11px, 70% opacity; It's not corporate, it's like a registration note.
must: Accent alert/action only; Not used in text bodies.
The title is serif and thin; body 16px/1.7.
Section spacing ≥ 72px; Cramped order is prohibited.
mustNot: Red on red text as horror cliché.
essence: Horror Occult establishes fear not with decoration but with emptiness and silence: the less the page speaks, the more unsettling it becomes.
brief: Design horror game menu: black background, thin serif header, blood red lone alert, wide spacing.

name: Racing Neon
tagline: Night racing language: cyan signal, magenta second tone, giant slanted hood and speed strips.
best: arcade racing game, night event, music/game campaign
signature: **Cyan accent:** single signal color; magenta secondary label only (accent 40%).
**Slanted header:** `skewX(-6deg)` H1 only; the body remains straight.
**Speed stripes:** 1px horizontal lines, 8% opacity, static.
**Sharp corner:** 0–4px; button 0px.
must: Single accent (cyan); The second color is limited to 40% opacity.
Numbers are taboos and mono.
The slant is only in the title; text body plain.
essence: Racing Neon uses neon sparingly: single cyan signal, static lines and sharp typography; There is no glow effect.
brief: Design night racing game page: black background, cyan single accent, tilted giant title, static speed lines.
